finalText:
Implementation complete. All 8/8 OpenSpec tasks are checked off, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass (26/26), and `TASK.md` plus the existing tests are untouched.

Working through the OpenSpec workflow (`order-apply-coupon` change):

- **proposal.md** — why and what, new `order-coupon` capability, impact on routes/services/repositories.
- **specs/order-coupon/spec.md** — 13 requirements covering normalization, validation, order state, coupon eligibility, the fixed error precedence, discount math, and atomic redemption.
- **design.md** — layering decision (routes parse, service rules, repository SQL), the transaction approach, rounding, and the cap interpretation.
- **tasks.md** — 8 tasks, all completed.
- **apply** — code and tests written and verified.

What changed in the code:

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts) | `applyCoupon(id, couponCode)` with the spec's check order, normalization, and discount math |
| [redemptionRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/redemptionRepository.ts) | New; runs the order update, redemption insert, and `used_count` increment in one `BEGIN`/`COMMIT` |
| [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts) | Registers `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` |
| [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts) | Wires the coupon and redemption repositories into `OrderService` |
| [applyCoupon.test.ts](/work/tests/applyCoupon.test.ts) | 21 tests across the acceptance criteria and every error code |

Two judgment calls I made and recorded in `design.md`:

- **Percent cap (REQ-07/AC-03).** The task doesn't give a numeric cap, so I implemented the discount cap via `coupon.maxDiscountCents` exactly as REQ-08 states (applies to both FIXED and PERCENT), plus the existing `min(discount, amountCents)` floor. I did not invent an arbitrary hardcoded percentage limit.
- **Percent rounding.** `Math.round(amountCents * value / 100)` — round half up; the acceptance examples are exact divisions, so this only affects non-divisible amounts.

One optional follow-up remains, which I left alone per your "stop when complete" instruction: archiving the change (`openspec archive`). Say the word if you'd like me to archive it and sync the capability into `openspec/specs/`.
